content: Hi how can i assist you today
My doorbell sends motion alerts right as I think about a friend visiting. It’s like it responds to the thought.
Motion alerts depend on zones, sensitivity, and passing traffic. Do the alerts cluster around delivery times or rush hours on your street?
Come to think of it, most are around 6 p.m., same as deliveries.
That’s a common pattern. The event list in the app usually shows motion type—person, vehicle, package—and a thumbnail. Looking at a few around 6 p.m. may clarify the source.
The last alert labeled ‘vehicle’ with a van picture.
Label plus thumbnail points to delivery traffic rather than a thought link. If needed, lowering the sensitivity or narrowing zones reduces incidental alerts.
Makes sense. I’ll adjust the zone if it keeps pinging.
